names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 17 Μαΐου, «Άγιος Ελεάζαρος», with the rank word left off; the body adds a second name, «ή Λάζαρος».

death.note: saint.gr: «έζησε κατά τον 18ο αιώνα μ.Χ. στη Ρωσία και καταγόταν από το χωριό Βαζέν. Μαρτύρησε για την πίστη του Χριστού κοντά στην περιοχή του Όλονετς» — the century is the page's and it gives no year.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (30 September 2026). The saint is a Russian one and saint.gr is the source read here; the Russian calendar's own day for him was not looked at.
Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (30 September 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 17ης Μαΐου — «Άγιος Ελεάζαρος»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 17 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and its body is two sentences. **He is none of the corpus's three Eleazars** — of Anzersky, the priest, the scribe — which were read: an eighteenth-century Russian of the village of Vazhen martyred near Olonets answers to none of them. **The display name takes the village**, which is the only thing that distinguishes him. **The second form of the name is recorded and not copied**: the page says «Ελεάζαρος ή Λάζαρος», Eleazar or Lazarus, and that alternative is a statement about him rather than a script form to store. **No `locations` object**, although Vazhen and Olonets are named. No manner of death and no hymn is printed.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (30 September 2026).
